# `WorldApi::get_cell_gas_velocity`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-engine-side">engine-side</span> <span class="sdk-kind">method</span>

Source: **World API** (`src/plugins/api/world_api.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Returns the cell-level velocity for a gas if that gas is present in the cell.

## Signature

```rust
fn get_cell_gas_velocity (& self , cell : UVec2 , substance : & str ,) -> Result < Vec2 , WorldApiError >
```

| Argument | Type | Description |

| `cell` | UVec2 | `cell` argument passed as `UVec2`. |
| `substance` | & str | `substance` argument passed as `& str`. |

## Return Value

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/methods/worldapi-get-cell-gas-velocity.md`](../../examples/methods/worldapi-get-cell-gas-velocity.md)_

```rust
let velocity = world.get_cell_gas_velocity(UVec2::new(24, 18), "oxygen")?;
if velocity.length() > 0.0 {
    println!("gas drift: {:?}", velocity);
}
```
